question: For any positive real number $x$ and any positive integer $n$, we can uniquely write $x=mn+r$, where $m$ is an integer (positive, negative or zero) and $0\le r<n$. With this notation we define $x\bmod n=r$. For example, $13.2\bmod3=1.2$. The number of discontinuity points of the function $f(x)=(x\bmod2)^2+(x\bmod4)$ in the interval $0<x<9$ is
